name: codex-auto-open
description: Open files edited by Codex in the current VS Code window.

codexAutoOpen.preserveFocus.description: Keep focus in Codex or the terminal when opening an edited file.

codexAutoOpen.preview.description: Open edited files as preview tabs rather than pinned tabs.

codexAutoOpen.revealDelayMs.description: Wait this many milliseconds to collect edits before opening tabs.

codexAutoOpen.dedupeMs.description: Suppress repeated events for the same file within this interval.

codexAutoOpen.maxTabsPerTurn.description: Maximum number of tabs opened automatically for one Codex turn.

codexAutoOpen.exclude.description: Additional workspace-relative glob patterns for files to skip. Common generated directories are always skipped.

scripts.package: npm run compile && node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('../dist',{recursive:true})" && vsce package --no-dependencies --allow-missing-repository --skip-license --out ../dist/codex-auto-open.vsix
